description: This file defines the ProjectBot class, which is part of the GoteoBot modeling layer. It manages project bot associations, including validation, database retrieval, and saving functionality within the project's backend.

classes.name: ProjectBot
classes.description: Represents a project bot entity with properties for project, platform, and channel ID. Provides methods for validation, database retrieval, and saving data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that project, platform, and channel ID are set; adds errors if any are missing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves project bot records from the database by project ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the object and saves it into the database, handling errors accordingly.
